notes.title: Broken Saves Patch
notes.content:
[p]Hello everyone, 

It's probably my 10th build today. Thanks to the help of a coder friend that plays the game, I may have been able to fix the broken saves. 
We ran this test on mutliple Steam accounts, with different saves, and it worked out every time. 

The patch is simple, open the broken saves, and you'll be met with a warning black screen and the message "Your save failed to load! Do you want to try and recover it?"

Just follow instructions, click once or twice, and create a new save. This new save will work and you will keep your progression. 

Thanks for your patience, 

MisterMaya[/p]

notes.title: Law School - Season 1 is coming on Steam!
notes.content:
[h2]Law School - Season 1 is officially complete![/h2]

See you all next month for the big release on [b]July 23rd 2025.[/b]

I’m incredibly excited to finally share this game with you after nearly two years of hard work and dedication.

As I write this update, Steam testers are reviewing the game. With five weeks left, I have just enough time to tackle the final tasks. My next priorities are:
[list]
[*][b]Adding the built-in official walkthrough directly in the game (no separate PDF needed)[/b]

[*][b]Implementing the Steam achievements for Season 1[/b]

[*][b]Completing the French translation[/b]
[/list]

[u]I’ll be working hard to make sure all of these are ready by launch day.[/u]

To stay up to date and not miss a thing, don’t forget to [b]wishlist[/b] the game — you’ll get notified about all release details.

Thank you all so much for your support. See you very soon!

MisterMaya

notes.title: Law School - Season 1 - Update #6
notes.content:
[h1]Hey everyone, and welcome to the final update for Law School – Season 1![/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45329292/6a47279e79106aea54a4584f5997ba8c5b3cbb0a.png[/img]

That’s right—the finish line is in sight!
Development is nearly complete, and I’ve just wrapped up the post-production phase of the final episode. Now, I’m preparing for the official launch on Steam.

[h2]Next up: Steam Next Fest begins next week![/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45329292/131045220540d1efaa90ac1f9548b5dfcda014fc.gif[/img]

This is your chance to dive deeper into Law School and get a taste of the full experience. The demo has been reworked with new features and updated renders—it’ll be going live again within the next few hours.

The full release is scheduled for July, but due to Steam's requirements, I won’t be announcing the exact date until the Fest wraps up. Expect a short update around June 17 to reveal the official launch day!

In the meantime, I’ll be updating the Store Page and working on a brand new, fully LEWD trailer—you won’t want to miss it.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45329292/7011866e12067d62db019e7287ce60693d370891.gif[/img]

Now let’s talk content. Here’s where things stand:

[h2]Season 1 Final Stats[/h2]
[b]📸 Images: 9,456
🎞️ Animations: 256
📜 Script: 137,760 words
🎮 Mini-Games: 7
🔥 Lewd Scenes: 17
🖼️ Unlockable Custom Images: 28
🎵 Soundtrack: 110 tracks
📱 Exclusive Facegram Posts: 74 (fully interactive)[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45329292/874dc2ccce061186a0d32712d62011257380157d.gif[/img]

I’m incredibly proud of how far the game has come. You’re looking at dozens of hours of gameplay, meaningful choices that shape your journey, and tons of secrets to uncover.

Both English and French will be available at launch, with Chinese, Turkish, and hopefully Russian coming shortly after. Other language options are still under consideration.

[h3]So… get ready. Wishlist the game, join us for Steam Fest, and I’ll see you in just over two weeks![/h3]

– MisterMaya
